name.ja: スパイダー・イート・スパイダー

text.en: Tribute 1 Insect monster from your hand or field; increase the Levels of all Insect monsters you currently control by the Level the Tributed monster had, then you can add 1 Insect monster from your Deck to your hand with the same Level as an Insect monster you control. You can banish this card from your GY and Tribute 1 Insect monster; draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Arachno-Cannibalism" once per turn.
